title.zh: 在三宝颜省设立 Molave 市镇并以其为该省首府的法案
title.en: An Act Creating the Municipality of Molave in the Province of Zamboanga and Making Said Municipality the Capital of the Province
title.orig: An Act Creating the Municipality of Molave in the Province of Zamboanga and Making Said Municipality the Capital of the Province

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_286_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The territory within the boundaries described in the next succeeding section in the Province of Zamboanga shall be a municipality to be known as the municipality of Molave.

The boundaries and limits of the territory of said municipality are established and defined as follows:
On the North by latitude 8º 20º 00º, adjoining the municipalities of Katipunan, Dipolog and Dapitan; on the East by the Misamis Occidental-Zamboanga boundary; on the South by latitude 8º 0º 00º, adjoining the municipalities of Aurora, Pagadian, Margosatubig; on the West by longitude 123º 10º 00º, adjoining the municipalities of Sindangan, Labason and Kabasalan. The area of the municipality of Molave is approximately nine hundred square kilometers.

Upon approval of this Act, or as soon thereafter as practicable, the President of the Philippines shall appoint the elective officials of the new municipality who shall hold office until their successors shall have been duly elected in the general elections next following the approval of this Act and have qualified.

The said municipality of Molave shall be the capital of the Province of Zamboanga: Provided, However, That until the necessary buildings to be used for housing the different offices of the provincial government of Zamboanga shall have been constructed in the said municipality, the municipality of Dipolog shall continue to be the capital of the province.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1948.
